User: Thanks, Linda. I'll think about it. I usually get a few each week. Appreciate your help.
Agent: Got it—thanks for sharing that. If you decide you want to see how we’d catch those after-hours voicemails and turn them into confirmed orders, just come back and we’ll pick it up from there. Take care.
